name: finger extensor stretch
description: Bending your fingers down stretches the muscles on the back of your forearm. Handy to loosen up after lots of gripping.
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
